notes:
- Before printing from the phone, Snap Mixer checks the toolheads the plate uses. If one is unloaded, still loading, or has a different filament type than the model asks for (e.g. PETG instead of PLA), it warns you first: Print anyway or Cancel.
- Also checked when you start a model that was already sliced.
- When choosing colors, unloaded toolheads are faded and marked "Unloaded".
- Slice only: just the filament type is checked, since you can load before tapping Print.
